name: Karwendelhof
beschreibung: Der Karwendelhof is located in the center of Seefeld, not far from the pedestrian zone and the parish church. The property combines traditional Tiroler architecture with modern comfort and offers a clear, functional setting for a stay. Guests will find a selection of rooms and apartments, a wellness area with sauna, and a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The hotel is suitable both for those seeking relaxation and for active guests planning hiking, cycling or cross-country skiing in the region. An underground garage and the hotel's own outdoor pool are also part of the amenities.
